_how_to_use: Drafts of SAFE requirements that are not yet in .colaberry/plan.json. This file only documents a draft: it never registers, approves or verifies anything, so do not add status fields here (a test rejects them). The Command Center reads registration from plan.json and sign-off and verification from progress.json. An enforcement check counts once its "test" names a test file that exists and passes. When the platform plan carries the requirement, keep the draft until the Guardrails tab shows it as registered, then remove it.

drafts.statement: The agent may report that the product does not match the design system, but only a human decides what the design system is.
sources: Ali Muwwakkil, email to Mihret asking for this to be typed as SAFE (the email is not stored in this repository)
docs/definitions/design_token_drift_audit.R0.md, section 5: a token-set gap is escalated as a design decision, never auto-substituted
docs/discovery/04-manager-interview.md, Q3: the agent reports differences but never proposes design-system changes

enforcement.check: Any scanner tool granted to the agent is read-only: no write path to token files, the design-system folder or brand-bridge.css
A run fails if anything tries to apply, commit or push a proposed fix (R0 section 7.2)
Only a human can add an exception-list entry; the agent can only propose one
A finding stays proposed until a human accepts it; the agent cannot mark its own finding accepted
